entry_contract: Continue from 53 Feralas, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Tanaris with Marin Noggenfogger. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Azshara to Tanaris. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G51.81,28.66 Tanaris]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to Tanaris and meet the first quest giver at [G51.81,28.66 Tanaris]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
Reach level 45 before accepting The Thirsty Goblin. [XP45 Level 45]
Accept [QA2605 The Thirsty Goblin] from Marin Noggenfogger.
Collect or use the required item: Laden Dew Gland. [QC2605 The Thirsty Goblin]
steps.objective_hint: Collect or use the required item: Laden Dew Gland

steps.instruction: Turn in [QT2605 The Thirsty Goblin] to Marin Noggenfogger
Accept [QA2606 In Good Taste] from Marin Noggenfogger.
Complete [QC2606 In Good Taste]

Accept [QA2641 Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient] from Sprinkle.

steps.objective_hint: Collect or use the required item: Violet Tragan

steps.instruction: Turn in [QT2641 Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient] to Sprinkle
